Relevant experience includes three (3) of experience with directory services and related protocols, DEVOPS automation, Storage Area Network/Network Attached Storage, and Network File System. Relevant experience also includes four (4) years of experience with network administration in a Cisco environment. An additional four (4) years of relevant experience and a cybersecurity certification (e.g., Security+) may be substituted for the bachelor’s degree. Must be willing and able to perform in a variety of 40-hour work-week configurations, including: Monday-Friday (5 x 8): 1st Shift Monday-Friday (5 x 8): 2nd Shift Variable 4 x 10 shifts that may include weekends (4 days on/3 days off) and may be 1st or 2nd shift Sliding (5 x 8) work weeks (Sunday-Thursday or Tuesday-Saturday) and may be 1st or 2nd shift Additionally, these work week configurations may rotate to meet mission requirements.
